text:
nina: Quick stand-up on private deploy roadmap slices. We need to pick a shipping slice for GA and a clear post-GA backlog. Short answers only.
chris: Propose GA slice: slim installer, operator basics, KMS support, tenant isolation, basic observability. Defer advanced networking.
tom: Field asks: preserved egress and predictable outbound IPs are top-third asks. Many customers will accept a managed relay for MVP.
raja: Engineering note: relay manager in operator is lower risk than full BGP. Relay also reduces infra coordination with customer's netops.
sara: QA: agree on relay first. Need an offline smoke test that includes install + sample workload + upgrade path. Can we define minimum smoke steps?
maria: Compliance: KMS + audit export must be in GA. Also require documented data-at-rest handling in runbook.
chris: Minimal smoke steps suggestion:
- install airgap bundle on test cluster
- create tenant + upload model
- send inference request (100 tokens)
- perform operator upgrade dry-run
- trigger rollback and validate state
- export audit log to S3/GCS stub
tom: Ops constraints: airgap bundle should aim < 450MB; anything larger means long customer transfer times. Delta patching reduces retransfer but is effort.
raja: Spike estimates: relay manager proto (3w), installer slimline (2w), BGP design spike (2w). We can parallelize relay + installer.
sara: Test infra ask: need a reproducible offline env (local VM or k8s-in-docker) for the smoke harness. QA volunteers? I'll assign.
maria: Legal: BGP peering adds contractual SLAs and operator access permissions. If we add BGP as paid feature, legal needs time for templates.
chris: Prioritization decision proposal: ship GA with relay + slim installer + KMS + tenant isolation. Mark BGP peering as "enterprise add-on" targeted next quarter.
nina: Any objections to that sequencing?
raja: No objections from eng. We should add a tech note about eventual BGP path and required CNI changes.
tom: Sales input: customers will accept GA if we offer migration concierge and a clear upgrade window policy. Put that in launch comms.
sara: QA asks for explicit upgrade dry-run in CI. Add to acceptance criteria.
chris: Draft GA acceptance (short):
- Installer: successful airgap install on supported k8s versions
- Relay: operator-managed relay that preserves outbound IP mapping for sessions
- KMS: integration tested with AWS/GCP + documented HSM path
- Tenant isolation: network + storage boundaries validated
- Rollback: operator restores prior model versions and storage state
- Smoke: automated harness passing in CI
- Docs: runbook + upgrade playbook + minimal network diagrams
maria: Add: default hardening profile + audit export steps.
nina: Risks (brief): bundle bloat, relay scale/perf, upgrade flakiness on older k8s, legal on BGP.
raja: Action items:
- ENG: start relay manager proto (ticket created)
- ENG: slim installer work (ticket created)
- QA: build offline smoke harness + upgrade dry-run tests
- PRODUCT: finalize GA comms and migration offering
- LEGAL: prepare BGP appendix if we accelerate it
deploy-bot: Created tickets: https://tracker.internal/RED-5021 "relay-manager proto" assigned to raja (due 2024-08-01), https://tracker.internal/RED-5022 "installer-slim" assigned to tom (due 2024-07-25), https://tracker.internal/RED-5023 "smoke-harness + upgrade-dryrun" assigned to sara (due 2024-07-30) :robot_face: 
chris: We'll re-evaluate BGP after two weeks of field feedback. Reconvene Wed next week to confirm slices.
nina: Thanks everyone. I'll put this checklist in the roadmap doc and ping for any edits. Ping me directly for blockers. :thumbsup:
